title: Marc Jacobs Daisy Eau So Fresh
text: I worked on Flash development and animation for the Daisy Eau So Fresh digital campaign. The website introduced the fragrance collection through product imagery and a floral visual theme. Its companion Facebook experience, the Eau So Fresh Finder, presented a visitor’s photos as “freshest moments.” The two parts gave the campaign different ways to connect with visitors: browsing the fragrance collection on the website and seeing personal photos inside its visual world. Both are preserved in the project’s archived screens.
summary: My work on the Daisy Eau So Fresh campaign included Flash development and animation, bringing fragrance imagery and a Facebook photo feature into its digital presentation.
